role: run.json mutation and task propagation plus typed runner-event emission, validation, lookup, processed mutation, and archive lifecycle

run_json.write_policy: read-modify-write under lock, tmp file, rename
run_json.timeout_policy: fail closed without mutation; callers may retry or reconcile but never write unlocked

event_file.parser: strict lowercase key-value lines split on first colon; six canonical fields are required exactly once before normalization, and optional extension fields must be lowercase, unique, and non-colliding
event_file.writer: web/lib/runner-v2/event-emitter.ts owns canonical bytes, validation, filenames, and atomic writes; shell-facing emit entrypoints only invoke it
event_file.lifecycle: web/lib/runner-v2/event-lifecycle.ts strictly lists, matches, marks processed, and archives owned event files; shell command boundaries only invoke its compiled CLI
event_file.source_of_truth: validated body fields only; filenames are persistence identities, never ownership fallback

task_update.completion_behavior: completed run reopens non-open task to open and writes summary comment

archive.triggered_event: the exact raw and normalized active trigger plus its file-generation token are captured before launches; under the lifecycle claim owned siblings are archived first, then strict processed trigger bytes and the immutable receipt are claimed before unchanged trigger bytes are unlinked last
archive.receipt: $EVENTS_DIR/archive/.event-receipt-<sha256(sourceFilename + NUL + runId)>-<fileGenerationToken>-<sha256(acceptedRawBytes)>.json; version 2 with role, monotonic occurrence, sourceFilename, runId, destinationFilename, occurrenceToken, acceptedContentSha256, acceptedRecordSha256, and archivedContentSha256
archive.retry_proof: completion discovery is active-file-only; missing-source consume requires the exact pre-launch file-generation token plus accepted raw and normalized hashes to select one trigger receipt, then validates the direct archive destination, archived SHA-256, strict processed body, run_id, owner, and optional expected event; old same-path receipts and byte-identical recreations cannot authorize a different occurrence, and an already-archived replay returns without scanning or consuming later live same-run/owner files
archive.owned_events: run_id plus source/agent exact identity or guarded delimiter-token identity
archive.forbidden: global archive sweep of sibling agents or other runs

invariants: agent success status is complete, run success status is completed
archive scope is run plus source/agent
archive receipts prove exact lifecycle identity and never act as event triggers or ownership fallback
schemas are not trusted over actual disk format
exported functions avoid heredoc bodies (export -f serialization hazard); run/event JSON is built via printf or jq -n (0c96b73, ebda700)
